items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Sally Cohen is the man's name who runs the place, Sally Cohen. Never forget him as long as I live.

ctx.x: teach skating?" No, no, no. "What do you do?" "I entertain." So we put our skates on our shoulder and walked from 47th Street, and between 47th and 48th on Broadway around to between 47th and 48th on 7th Avenue, which is only half a block, it's about half a block when you measure it 'cause it runs into a point, you know, 47th runs into a point to 49th Street and Broadway. Get what I mean? Get what I'm sayin'?

However, we go around there and I get Mr. Sally Cohen is the man's name who runs the place, Sally Cohen. Never forget him as long as I live. And I called him to tell him what happened. He said just a minute. Now he's heard us enough, over two hours singing, playing piano. So he knows about this agent, he knows about him. So he called him up to tell him to come over, he ought to hear somebody, he had somebody he wanted him to hear. So he comes over. Now he doesn't tell on the phone my story but he waits to get him…
what has happened. Well, when he tells him what has happened when he's over there. The man says, don't worry about it. He heard us now, heard us sing, he wants us to go on in his act.
